title_en: One Spoonful of Honey Is the Life of 12 Bees #Shorts
desc_en:
A worker bee makes about 1/12 of a teaspoon of honey in her whole life. One teaspoon is the life's work of about 12 bees.

Source: PBS NOVA, "The Buzz About Bees" (approximate figure).
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
desc_ko:
일벌 한 마리가 평생 만드는 꿀은 약 12분의 1 티스푼입니다. 티스푼 하나는 꿀벌 약 12마리의 일생입니다.

출처: PBS NOVA, "The Buzz About Bees"(대략적인 값)
